verses.geez:
ወአልቦሙ ፡ መክፈልተ ፡ ካህናት ፡ ወሌዋውያን ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ሌዊ ፡ ምስለ ፡ እስራኤል ፤ መባኡ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡
                  ክፍሎሙ ፡ ወኪያሁ ፡ ይሴሰዩ ።
verses.translation: The priests, the Levites, even the whole tribe of Levi, shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel; the burnt-offerings of the Lord are their inheritance, they shall eat them.

translations.lxx: The priests, the Levites, even the whole tribe of Levi, shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel; the burnt-offerings of the Lord are their inheritance, they shall eat them.
translations.kjv: The priests the Levites, and all the tribe of Levi, shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel: they shall eat the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and his inheritance.
translations.ron: "Preoţii, leviţii şi toată seminţia lui Levi nu va avea parte şi moştenire cu Israel; aceştia să se hrănească cu jertfele Domnului şi cu partea Lui;
translations.grk: Οὐκ ἔσται τοῖς ἱερεῦσι τοῖς Λευίταις ὅλῃ φυλῇ Λευὶ μερὶς οὐδὲ κλῆρος μετὰ Ἰσραήλ· καρπώματα Κυρίου ὁ κλῆρος αὐτῶν, φάγονται αὐτά.

verses.geez: ወክፍለ ፡ ባሕቱ ፡ አልቦሙ ፡ በውስተ ፡ አኀዊሆሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ክፍሉ ፡ በከመ ፡ ይቤሎ ።
verses.translation: And they shall have no inheritance among their brethren; the Lord himself is his portion, as he said to him.

translations.lxx: And they shall have no inheritance among their brethren; the Lord himself is his portion, as he said to him.
translations.kjv: Therefore shall they have no inheritance among their brethren: the LORD is their inheritance, as he hath said unto them.
translations.ron: Iar moştenire nu va avea el între fraţii săi, căci Domnul însuşi este moştenirea lui, precum i-a grăit El.
translations.grk: Κλῆρος δὲ οὐκ ἔσται αὐτοῖς ἐν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτῶν· Κύριος αὐτὸς κλῆρος αὐτοῦ, καθότι εἶπεν αὐτῷ.

verses.geez:
ወዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ሕጎሙ ፡ ለካህናት ፡ ዘእምኀበ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ እለ ፡ ይጠብኁ ፡ ጥብኀ ፡ እመኒ ፡ ላህመ ፡ ወእመኒ ፡
                  በግዐ ፡ ዘይሁብዎ ፡ ለካህን ፡ መዝራዕተ ፡ ወሕልቀ ፡ ወቈስጤ ።
verses.translation: And this is the due of the priests in the things coming from the people from those who offer sacrifices, whether it be a calf or a sheep; and thou shalt give the shoulder to the priest, and the cheeks, and the great intestine:

translations.lxx: And this is the due of the priests in the things coming from the people from those who offer sacrifices, whether it be a calf or a sheep; and thou shalt give the shoulder to the priest, and the cheeks, and the great intestine:
translations.kjv: And this shall be the priest’s due from the people, from them that offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep; and they shall give unto the priest the shoulder, and the two cheeks, and the maw.
translations.ron: Iată ce să se dea preoţilor de la popor: cei ce aduc ca jertfă boi sau oi să dea preotului spata, fălcile şi stomacul.
translations.grk: Καὶ αὕτη ἡ κρίσις τῶν ἱερέων τὰ παρὰ τοῦ λαοῦ παρὰ τῶν θυόντων τὰ θύματα, ἐάν τε μόσχον, ἐάν τε πρόβατον· καὶ δώσεις τὸν βραχίονα τῷ ἱερεῖ, καὶ τὰ σιαγόνια, καὶ τὸ ἔνυστρον,

verses.geez: ወቀዳሜ ፡ እክልከ ፡ ወቀዳሜ ፡ ወይንከ ፡ ወቀዳሜ ፡ ቅብእከ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ዘቀረፅከ ፡ አባግዒከ ፡ ትሁቦ ።
verses.translation: and the first-fruits of thy corn, and of thy wine, and of thine oil; and thou shalt give to him the first-fruits of the fleeces of thy sheep:

translations.lxx: and the first-fruits of thy corn, and of thy wine, and of thine oil; and thou shalt give to him the first-fruits of the fleeces of thy sheep:
translations.kjv: The firstfruit also of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the first of the fleece of thy sheep, shalt thou give him.
translations.ron: De asemenea pârga de la grâul tău, de la vinul tău şi de la untdelemnul tău, pârga de lână de la oile tale să i-o dai lui,
translations.grk: καὶ τὰς ἀπαρχὰς τοῦ σίτου σου, καὶ τοῦ οἴνου σου, καὶ τοῦ ἐλαίου σου· καὶ τὴν ἀπαρχὴν τῶν κουρῶν τῶν προβάτων σου δώσεις αὐτῷ.

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ ኀር[ዮ] ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክነ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕዘቢከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይቁም ፡ ቅድሜሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር
                  ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ወይትለአኮ ፡ ወይባርክ ፡ በስመ ፡ ዚአሁ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወደቂቁ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ መዋዕል ።
verses.translation: because the Lord has chosen him out of all thy tribes, to stand before the Lord thy God, to minister and bless in his name, himself and his sons among the children of Israel.

translations.lxx: because the Lord has chosen him out of all thy tribes, to stand before the Lord thy God, to minister and bless in his name, himself and his sons among the children of Israel.
translations.kjv: For the LORD thy God hath chosen him out of all thy tribes, to stand to minister in the name of the LORD, him and his sons for ever.
translations.ron: Că pe el l-a ales Domnul Dumnezeul tău din toate seminţiile tale, ca să stea înaintea Domnului Dumnezeului tău şi să slujească întru numele Domnului, el şi fiii lui în toate zilele.
translations.grk: Ὅτι αὐτὸν ἐξελέξατο Κύριος ἐκ πασῶν τῶν φυλῶν σου, παρεστάναι ἔναντι Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ, λειτουργεῖν καὶ εὐλογεῖν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ, αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez:
ወለእመ ፡ መጽአ ፡ ሌዋዊ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ አህጉሪክሙ ፡ ዘእምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ዘኀበ ፡ ይነብር ፡ ውእቱ
                  ፡ እስመ ፡ ፈተወ ፡ በነፍሱ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይትለአክ ፡ በውእቱ ፡ መካን ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኀርየ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፤
verses.translation: And if a Levite come from one of the cities of all the children of Israel, where he himself dwells, accordingly as his mind desires, to the place which he shall have chosen,

translations.lxx: And if a Levite come from one of the cities of all the children of Israel, where he himself dwells, accordingly as his mind desires, to the place which he shall have chosen,
translations.kjv: And if a Levite come from any of thy gates out of all Israel, where he sojourned, and come with all the desire of his mind unto the place which the LORD shall choose;
translations.ron: De va pleca levitul din una din cetăţile tale, din tot pământul fiilor lui Israel, unde locuieşte, şi va veni, după dorinţa sufletului său, la locul ce 1-a ales Domnul,
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ παραγένηται ὁ Λευίτης ἐκ μιᾶς τῶν πόλεων ἐκ πάντων τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ, οὗ αὐτὸς παροικεῖ, καθʼ ὅτι ἐπιθυμεῖ ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ, εἰς τὸν τόπον ὃν ἂν ἐκλέξηται,

verses.geez:
ወይትቀነይ ፡ ለስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላኩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አኀዊሁ ፡ ሌዋውያን ፡ እለ ፡ ይቀውሙ ፡ ህየ ፡ ቅድመ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: he shall minister to the name of the Lord his God, as all his brethren the Levites, who stand there present before the Lord thy God.

translations.lxx: he shall minister to the name of the Lord his God, as all his brethren the Levites, who stand there present before the Lord thy God.
translations.kjv: Then he shall minister in the name of the LORD his God, as all his brethren the Levites do, which stand there before the LORD.
translations.ron: Şi va sluji în numele Domnului Dumnezeului tău, ca toţi fraţii săi leviţi care stau înaintea Domnului,
translations.grk: λειτουργήσει τῷ ὀνόματι Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ αὐτοῦ, ὥσπερ πάντες οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ οἱ Λευῖται οἱ παρεστηκότες ἐκεῖ ἐναντίον Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου.

verses.geez: ይትከፈል ፡ መክፈልቶ ፡ ወይሴሰይ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ዘበ ፡ ሢመቱ ፡ ዘበ ፡ ሀገሩ ።
verses.translation: He shall eat an allotted portion, besides the sale of his hereditary property.

translations.lxx: He shall eat an allotted portion, besides the sale of his hereditary property.
translations.kjv: They shall have like portions to eat, beside that which cometh of the sale of his patrimony.
translations.ron: Să se folosească de aceeaşi parte ca şi ceilalţi, pe lângă cele primite din vânzarea moştenirii părinteşti.
translations.grk: Μερίδα μεμερισμένην φάγεται, πλὴν τῆς πράσεως τῆς κατὰ πατριάν.

verses.geez:
ወለእመ ፡ ቦእከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ እንተ ፡ ይሁበከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ኢትትመሀር ፡ ገቢረ ፡ ከመ ፡
                  ርኵሶሙ ፡ ለውእቶሙ ፡ አሕዛብ ።
verses.translation: And when thou shalt have entered into the land which the Lord thy God gives thee, thou shalt not learn to do according to the abominations of those nations.

translations.lxx: And when thou shalt have entered into the land which the Lord thy God gives thee, thou shalt not learn to do according to the abominations of those nations.
translations.kjv: When thou art come into the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not learn to do after the abominations of those nations.
translations.ron: Când vei intra tu în pământul ce ţi-l dă Domnul Dumnezeul tău, să nu te deprinzi a face urâciunile pe care le fac popoarele acestea.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ εἰσέλθῃς εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου δίδωσί σοι, οὐ μαθήσῃ ποιεῖν κατὰ τὰ βδελύγματα τῶν ἐθνῶν ἐκείνων.

verses.geez:
ወኢይትረከብ ፡ በውስቴትክሙ ፡ ዘይሠውዕ ፡ ወልዶ ፡ አው ፡ ወለቶ ፡ በእሳት ፡ ወዘያስተቀስም ፡ መቅሰመ ፡ ወዘያስተሰግል
                  ፡ ወዘይጤየር ፤
verses.translation: There shall not be found in thee one who purges his son or his daughter with fire, one who uses divination, who deals with omens, and augury,

translations.lxx: There shall not be found in thee one who purges his son or his daughter with fire, one who uses divination, who deals with omens, and augury,
translations.kjv: There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, or that useth divination, or an observer of times, or an enchanter, or a witch.
translations.ron: Să nu se găsească la tine de aceia care trec pe fiul sau fiica lor prin foc, nici prezicător, sau ghicitor, sau vrăjitor, sau fermecător,
translations.grk: Οὐχ εὑρεθήσεται ἐν σοὶ περικαθαίρων τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν θυγατέρα αὐτοῦ ἐν πυρὶ, μαντευόμενος μαντείαν, κληδονιζόμενος, καὶ οἰωνιζόμενος, φαρμακοῖς

verses.geez: ወዘሥራይ ፡ ወዘሐርስ ፡ ወዘበፃውዕ ፡ ወዘያነቅህ ፡ ምውተ ፡ ወዘያስተሰግል ፡ በዖፍ ።
verses.translation: a sorcerer employing incantation, one who has in him a divining spirit, an observer of signs, questioning the dead.

translations.lxx: a sorcerer employing incantation, one who has in him a divining spirit, an observer of signs, questioning the dead.
translations.kjv: Or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or a necromancer.
translations.ron: Nici descântător, nici chemător de duhuri, nici mag, nici de cei ce grăiesc cu morţii.
translations.grk: ἐπαείδων ἐπαοιδὴν, ἐγγαστρίμυθος, καὶ τερατοσκόπος, ἐπερωτῶν τοὺς νεκρούς.

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ ርኩስ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘይገብሮ ፡ ለዝንቱ ፡ በኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እስመ ፡ በበይነ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ርኵሶሙ ፡
                  ያጠፍኦሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እምኔከ ።
verses.translation: For every one that does these things is an abomination to the Lord thy God; for because of these abominations the Lord will destroy them from before thy face.

translations.lxx: For every one that does these things is an abomination to the Lord thy God; for because of these abominations the Lord will destroy them from before thy face.
translations.kjv: For all that do these things are an abomination unto the LORD: and because of these abominations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee.
translations.ron: Căci urâciune este înaintea Domnului tot cel ce face acestea, şi pentru această urâciune îi izgoneşte Domnul Dumnezeul tău de la faţa ta.
translations.grk: Ἔστι γὰρ βδέλυγμα Κυρίῳ τῷ Θεῷ σου πᾶς ποιῶν ταῦτα· ἕνεκεν γὰρ τῶν βδελυγμάτων τούτων Κύριος ἐξολοθρεύσει αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ προσώπου σου.

verses.geez: ወኩን ፡ ፍጹመ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ።
verses.translation: Thou shalt be perfect before the Lord thy God.

translations.lxx: Thou shalt be perfect before the Lord thy God.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt be perfect with the LORD thy God.
translations.ron: Iar tu fii fără prihană înaintea Domnului Dumnezeului tău;
translations.grk: Τέλειος ἔσῃ ἐναντίον Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου.

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ እልክቱ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ እለ ፡ አንተ ፡ ትትወረሶሙ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ያስተሰግሉ ፡ ወያጸምኡ ፡ መቅሰመ ፡ ወለከሰ ፡
                  አኮ ፡ ከማሁ ።
verses.translation: For all these nations whose land thou shalt inherit, they will listen to omens and divinations; but the Lord thy God has not permitted thee so to do.

translations.lxx: For all these nations whose land thou shalt inherit, they will listen to omens and divinations; but the Lord thy God has not permitted thee so to do.
translations.kjv: For these nations, which thou shalt possess, hearkened unto observers of times, and unto diviners: but as for thee, the LORD thy God hath not suffered thee so to do.
translations.ron: Căci popoarele acestea, pe care le izgoneşti tu, ascultă de ghicitori şi de prevestitori, iar ţie nu-ţi îngăduie aceasta Domnul Dumnezeul tău.
translations.grk: Τὰ γὰρ ἔθνη ταῦτα, οὓς σὺ κατακληρονομεῖς αὐτοὺς, οὗτοι κληδόνων καὶ μαντειῶν ἀκούσονται· καί σοι οὐχ οὕτως ἔδωκε Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου.

verses.geez:
ነቢየ ፡ ወሀበከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ አኀዊከ ፡ ዘከማየ ፡ ወያነሥእ ፡ ለከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  አምላክከ ፡ ወሎቱ ፡ ስምዕዎ ፡ በኵሉ ።
verses.translation: The Lord thy God shall raise up to thee a prophet of thy brethren, like me; him shall ye hear:

translations.lxx: The Lord thy God shall raise up to thee a prophet of thy brethren, like me; him shall ye hear:
translations.kjv: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;
translations.ron: Prooroc din mijlocul tău şi din fraţii tăi, ca şi mine, îţi va ridica Domnul Dumnezeul tău: pe Acela să-L ascultaţi.
translations.grk: Προφήτην ἐκ τῶν ἀδελφῶν σου, ὡς ἐμὲ, ἀναστήσει σοι Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου· αὐτοῦ ἀκούσεσθε·

verses.geez:
ወኵሉ ፡ ዘሰአልካሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ በኮሬብ ፡ አመ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ተጋባእክሙ ፡ ወትቤሉ ፡ ኢንድግም ፡ እንከ
                  ፡ ሰሚዖተ ፡ ቃሎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክነ ፡ ወዛቲኒ ፡ እሳት ፡ ዐባይ ፡ ኢንርአያ ፡ እንከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢንሙት ።
verses.translation: according to all things which thou didst desire of the Lord thy God in Choreb in the day of the assembly, saying, We will not again hear the voice of the Lord thy God, and we will not any more see this great fire, and so we shall not die.

translations.lxx: according to all things which thou didst desire of the Lord thy God in Choreb in the day of the assembly, saying, We will not again hear the voice of the Lord thy God, and we will not any more see this great fire, and so we shall not die.
translations.kjv: According to all that thou desiredst of the LORD thy God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, Let me not hear again the voice of the LORD my God, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I die not.
translations.ron: Că tu la Horeb, în ziua adunării, ai cerut de la Domnul Dumnezeul tău şi ai zis: Să nu mai aud glasul Domnului Dumnezeului meu şi focul acesta mare să nu-l mai văd, ca să nu mor.
translations.grk: Κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ᾐτήσω παρὰ Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου ἐν Χωρὴβ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς ἐκκλησίας, λέγοντες, οὐ προσθήσομεν ἀκοῦσαι τὴν φωνὴν Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου, καὶ τὸ πῦρ τοῦτο τὸ μὲγα οὐκ ὀψόμεθα ἔτι, οὐδὲ μὴ ἀποθάνωμεν.

verses.geez: ወይቤለኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አማን ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘይቤሉ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to me, They have spoken rightly all that they have said to thee.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to me, They have spoken rightly all that they have said to thee.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, They have well spoken that which they have spoken.
translations.ron: Atunci mi-a zis Domnul: Bine este ceea ce ţi-au spus ei.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος πρὸς μὲ, ὀρθῶς πάντα ὅσα ἐλάλησαν πρὸς σέ.

verses.geez:
ነቢየ ፡ ኣነሥእ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ አኀዊሆሙ ፡ ዘከማከ ፡ ወእሁብ ፡ ቃልየ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አፉሁ ፡ ወይነግሮሙ ፡ ዘከመ
                  ፡ አዘዝክዎ ።
verses.translation: I will raise up to them a prophet of their brethren, like thee; and I will put my words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them as I shall command him.

translations.lxx: I will raise up to them a prophet of their brethren, like thee; and I will put my words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them as I shall command him.
translations.kjv: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brethren, like unto thee, and will put my words in his mouth; and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him.
translations.ron: Eu le voi ridica Prooroc din mijlocul fraţilor lor, cum eşti tu, şi voi pune cuvintele Mele în gura Lui şi El le va grăi tot ce-I voi porunci Eu.
translations.grk: Προφήτην ἀναστήσω αὐτοῖς ἐκ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν, ὥσπερ σέ· καὶ δώσω τὰ ῥήματα ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτοῦ, καὶ λαλήσει αὐτοῖς καθʼ ὅτι ἂν ἐντείλωμαι αὐτῷ.

verses.geez: ወብእሲ ፡ ዘኢይሰምዖ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ነቢይ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ዘነገረ ፡ በስመ ፡ ዚአየ ፡ አነ ፡ እትቤቀል ፡ እምኔሁ ።
verses.translation: And whatever man shall not hearken to whatsoever words that prophet shall speak in my name, I will take vengeance on him.

translations.lxx: And whatever man shall not hearken to whatsoever words that prophet shall speak in my name, I will take vengeance on him.
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever will not hearken unto my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.
translations.ron: Iar cine nu va asculta cuvintele Mele, pe care Proorocul Acela le va grăi în numele Meu, aceluia îi voi cere socoteală.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἐὰν μὴ ἀκούσῃ ὅσα ἂν λαλήσῃ ὁ προφήτης ἐκεῖνος ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου, ἐγὼ ἐκδικήσω ἐξ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወባሕቱ ፡ ነቢይ ፡ ዘይኤብስ ፡ ወይነብብ ፡ ቃለ ፡ በስምየ ፡ ዘኢአዘዝክዎ ፡ ይንብብ ፡ ወዘነበበሂ ፡ በስመ ፡ ባዕድ ፡
                  አማልክት ፡ ለይሙት ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ነቢይ ።
verses.translation: But the prophet whosoever shall impiously speak in my name a word which I have not commanded him to speak, and whosoever shall speak in the name of other gods, that prophet shall die.

translations.lxx: But the prophet whosoever shall impiously speak in my name a word which I have not commanded him to speak, and whosoever shall speak in the name of other gods, that prophet shall die.
translations.kjv: But the prophet, which shall presume to speak a word in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or that shall speak in the name of other gods, even that prophet shall die.
translations.ron: Iar proorocul care va îndrăzni să grăiască în numele Meu ceea ce nu i-am poruncit Eu să grăiască, şi care va grăi în numele altor dumnezei, pe un astfel de prooroc să-l daţi morţii.
translations.grk: Πλὴν ὁ προφήτης ὃς ἂν ἀσεβήσῃ λαλῆσαι ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου ῥῆμα ὃ οὐ προσέταξα λαλῆσαι, καὶ ὃς ἂν λαλήσῃ ἐν ὀνόματι θεῶν ἑτέρων, ἀποθανεῖται ὁ προφήτης ἐκεῖνος.

verses.geez: ወለእመ ፡ ትብል ፡ በልብከ ፡ እፎ ፡ ኣአምር ፡ ቃለ ፡ ዘኢይቤ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፤
verses.translation: But if thou shalt say in thine heart, How shall we know the word which the Lord has not spoken?

translations.lxx: But if thou shalt say in thine heart, How shall we know the word which the Lord has not spoken?
translations.kjv: And if thou say in thine heart, How shall we know the word which the LORD hath not spoken?
translations.ron: De vei zice în inima ta: Cum vom cunoaşte Cuvântul pe care nu-l grăieşte Domnul?
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ εἴπῃς ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ σου, πῶς γνωσόμεθα τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ οὐκ ἐλάλησε Κύριος;

verses.geez:
እምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘነበበ ፡ ነቢይ ፡ በስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እምከመ ፡ ኢበጽሐ ፡ ቃሉ ፡ ወኢኮነ ፡ በከመ ፡ [ይቤ ፡]
                  ኢነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ቃል ፡ ወበሐሰት ፡ ነበበ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ነቢይ ፡ ወኢትስምዕዎ ።
verses.translation: Whatsoever words that prophet shall speak in the name of the Lord, and they shall not come true, and not come to pass, this is the thing which the Lord has not spoken; that prophet has spoken wickedly: ye shall not spare him.

translations.lxx: Whatsoever words that prophet shall speak in the name of the Lord, and they shall not come true, and not come to pass, this is the thing which the Lord has not spoken; that prophet has spoken wickedly: ye shall not spare him.
translations.kjv: When a prophet speaketh in the name of the LORD, if the thing follow not, nor come to pass, that is the thing which the LORD hath not spoken, but the prophet hath spoken it presumptuously: thou shalt not be afraid of him.
translations.ron: Dacă proorocul vorbeşte în numele Domnului, dar Cuvântul acela nu se va împlini şi nu se va adeveri, atunci nu grăieşte Domnul Cuvântul acela, ci-l grăieşte proorocul din îndrăzneala lui; nu te teme de el".
translations.grk: Ὅσα ἐὰν λαλήσῃ ὁ προφήτης ἐκεῖνος τῷ ὀνόματι Κυρίου, καὶ μὴ γένηται, καὶ μὴ συμβῇ, τοῦτο τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ οὐκ ἐλάλησε Κύριος, ἐν ἀσεβείᾳ ἐλάλησεν ὁ προφήτης ἐκεῖνος· οὐκ ἀφέξεσθε αὐτοῦ.
